imageReviewer.observations: Actual original Cylinder, Cone, Sphere and Torus from docs/journey/checks/75-round.rs, all contained with smooth-looking shading and finely sampled circular contours. A short black edge arc remains near the sphere top, and the torus has a visible right seam and lower ring boundary; these visible topology-edge chains are retained explicitly, not claimed absent or artifact-free. The source draw asserts BRep face counts3/2/1/1 and original round boundaries. Source structural audit confirms sphere edge0 is its exact meridian with own south/north endpoints; degenerate poleedges1/2 are skipped. Torus edges0/1 are explicitly declared periodic3D iso-seams with ownvertex0→0. Actual drawpoints evaluate those own curves, not triangle coordinates. Numeric endpoint residual was not separately measured.
